name: edition_id
description: The identifier assigned by the Publishing API to the current English-language edition representing the organisation.

name: acronym
description: The organisation’s acronym, if it has one.

name: brand
description: The organisation’s brand class name, which is mapped to a colour in the GOV.UK frontend.

name: organisation_type
description: The type assigned to the organisation in the Publishing API e.g. executive_ndpb, ministerial_department, devolved_administration, etc.

name: foi_exempt
description: Indicates whether the organisation is exempt from Freedom of Information requests.

name: organisation_status
description: The organisation’s status on GOV.UK. Permitted values include changed_name, merged, no_longer_exists, etc.

name: organisation_status_updated_at
description: The date and time associated with an update to the organisation’s GOV.UK status, where recorded.

name: organisation_status_url
description: A URL associated with the organisation’s GOV.UK status, where recorded.

name: parents
description: The edition IDs of organisations recorded directly above this organisation in the GOV.UK organisation hierarchy.

name: immediate_successors
description: The edition IDs of organisations recorded as directly succeeding this organisation.

name: ancestors
description: The edition IDs of organisations recorded at any level above this organisation in the GOV.UK organisation hierarchy. The array also includes this organisation’s own edition_id.

name: all_successors
description: The edition IDs of organisations in the recorded succession chain for this organisation, including direct and later successors. The array also includes this organisation’s own edition_id.
